publication_count_policy: Published totals include the one documentation commit that publishes this snapshot; the publisher verifies the pinned resulting history count.
method: git rev-list HEAD; git rev-list --all; git log --all metadata; pinned GitHub commits REST pagination; union/intersection of full SHAs. Every local SHA appears once. Local HEAD ancestry is a subset, never an additional repository total.
limitations: Unique Git objects are not unique logical patches or finished features; cherry-picks can have separate SHAs.
The source ledger contains commit metadata, not a source-tree upload or imported Git objects.
Uncommitted work and later release freezes are outside committed-source counts.
Author and committer dates are not package promotion times.
Subjects follow the public wording policy; hashes and timestamps remain unchanged.
